summary: Crest uses space-related data and reference materials to help us understand the background of space missions and inspire our project design and development. We also use relevant information, images, texts, and tools to support the creation of our project. All resources and references used will be listed to ensure that the sources of information are clear and properly acknowledged.
details:
Our project focuses on exploring and sharing the stories of equipment left behind on the Moon during NASA's space missions.

The project helps people understand what these objects are, why they were left on the Moon, and how they contributed to space exploration. Through storytelling and visual information, we make space history more interesting and easier for the public to understand.

The intended impact of our project is to increase awareness of the history of lunar exploration and encourage people, especially students, to develop an interest in space science.

We use NASA websites, space-related data, images, research materials, and digital tools to collect information and develop our project. We carefully select relevant information and organize it into an engaging presentation.

Our project is creative because it looks at space exploration from a different perspective. Instead of focusing only on astronauts and successful missions, we tell the stories of the objects that were left behind. We believe that even abandoned equipment has an important story worth remembering.
